description: Week-by-week NASS crop progress for corn, soybeans, or wheat across the growing season — each week's share of the crop at each growth stage (planted, emerged, silking, harvested, and similar) — from USDA NASS QuickStats. Use to track season pace or compare against earlier weeks; use get_crop_progress instead when only the latest week matters. Read-only lookup of stored statistics; no API key. Returns up to `weeks` most recent stored weeks, oldest first (default 12, max 52); the stages present vary by commodity and point in the season. Coverage is the current season, national plus major corn-belt states, and the stored copy refreshes weekly.

geography.description: US for national, or state code (IA, IL, etc.); state coverage is the major corn-belt states. Default: US

weeks.description: Number of most recent weeks to return (default 12, max 52)

name: get_crop_progress_history
